title: A variational approach to the generalized Fisher transformation of correlation matrices
abstract: arXiv:2609.19028v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The generalized Fisher transformation maps a non-singular correlation matrix to an unconstrained real vector through the off-diagonal elements of its matrix logarithm. We show that the inverse transformation is the unique minimizer of a smooth, strictly convex and coercive function of the diagonal elements of the matrix logarithm, which yields a new and short proof that the transformation is one-to-one and onto. The Hessian of this function is bounded, at every point, between the extreme eigenvalues of the associated matrix exponential and is dominated by the diagonal of that exponential, a bound that is attained. These bounds identify the standard fixed-point iteration for the inverse as a quasi-Newton method whose worst-case local factor can approach one for near-singular correlation matrices, and guarantee that the Newton system is never worse conditioned than the matrix exponential. translated_title: 相关矩阵广义Fisher变换的变分方法
translated_abstract: 广义Fisher变换通过其矩阵对数的非对角元素，将一个非奇异相关矩阵映射为一个无约束的实向量。我们证明该逆变换是矩阵对数对角元素的一个光滑、严格凸且强制（coercive）函数的唯一极小化子，这为该变换是一一对应且满射的这一事实提供了一个新的简短证明。该函数的Hessian矩阵在每一点处的界都介于相应矩阵指数的极端特征值之间，并且被该指数的对角元素所控制，这一界是可以达到的。这些界表明，求逆的标准不动点迭代是一种拟牛顿方法，对于近奇异相关矩阵，其最坏情况下的局部收敛因子可能趋近于1，同时保证牛顿方程组的条件数永远不会比矩阵指数的条件数更差。我们提出了GFT-FP+N方法，它在不动点迭代的基础上增强……
tldr: 本文通过构造一个光滑严格凸函数，证明广义Fisher变换的逆变换是其唯一极小化子，从而给出该变换双射性的新证明，并据此提出了结合不动点迭代与牛顿法的稳健算法GFT-FP+N。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the inverse generalized Fisher transformation is the unique minimizer of a smooth, strictly convex function, providing a new short proof of the transformation's bijectivity and motivating a robust hybrid fixed-point-plus-Newton algorithm (GFT-FP+N).
